name: Somali Ostrich
rangeDescription: Desert to savanna plains of northeastern africa, from northern ethiopia, djibouti, and somalia southward through far southeastern south sudan, and southeastern kenya
description: A long-legged and long-necked flightless bird. Males have a blue-gray neck and legs, but the bill and front of the legs become pink when breeding.

name: Humaita Antbird
rangeDescription: Western amazonian brazil (east to the rio madeira), southeastern peru (eastern madre de dios), and northern bolivia (pando)
description: Understory antbird of wet, forested habitats. Males are evenly gray; females are warm brown.

name: Arctic Tern
rangeDescription: Arctic circumpolar; winters sub-antarctic and antarctic seas
description: Elegant seabird with extremely long wings and forked tail. Adults are pale gray with white cheek, black cap, and red bill and legs.

name: Striped Crake
rangeDescription: Locally in sub-saharan africa
description: Small brown crake with conspicuous striping on the back. The underparts are brown in the male and gray in the female.

name: Green Warbler-Finch
rangeDescription: Galapagos (santiago, rábida, pinzón, isabela, fernandina, and santa cruz)
description: Small, slender-billed Galápagos finch. Best identified by its thin bill, brownish-gray plumage, and the island on which it is seen.

name: Dybowski's Twinspot
rangeDescription: Discontinuously distributed from southeastern senegal to guinea, eastward to northeastern democratic republic of the congo, southern south sudan, and northwestern uganda
description: An unusual dark twinspot with a gray hood, a red back and rump, and large white “twin spots” on the belly. Found in areas of tall grass, both in lush savanna and along forest edge.

name: Beautiful Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Sikkim and bhutan to yunnan, myanmar, and northwestern tonkin
description: An unmistakable and fairly uncommon large nuthatch: combination of orange belly, white face, and dazzling blue banding on the wings is unique in its family. Forages in primary forests, probing beneath bark, leaves, and treetop vegetation.

name: Tacarcuna Warbler
rangeDescription: Local in highlands of central panama (panamá and guna yala), eastern panama (cerra tacarcuna, darién), and adjacent northwestern colombia (chocó)
description: A nondescript warbler with a very small range near the border of Panama and Colombia. Dull brown overall, slightly paler buffy below, with a striped head.

name: Wallace's Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (sumbawa and flores)
description: A large scops-owl restricted to Flores and Sumbawa. Grayish-brown overall.

name: Sind Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Arid woodland and desert scrub of southeastern iran to pakistan
description: Only black-and-white woodpecker in most of its range. Note the big white shoulder patches and white bars on the black back.

name: Forest Owlet
rangeDescription: Known from 7 19th century specimens from northwestern maharashtra, orissa, and chhattisgarh; rediscovered in taloda area, maharashtra after hiatus of 113 years; now known from deciduous forest mainly in surat dangs (gujarat), northwestern maharashtra, and melghat tiger reserve (western madhya pradesh)
description: Extremely localized small owl, restricted to parts of west-central India. Known locations are in lowland forest between 200 and 600 meters of elevation; appears to favor teak forests.

name: White-tailed Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Southern mexico (sierra madre del sur from guerrero to western oaxaca)
description: Rather local but distinctive, medium-sized hummingbird found in foothills of the Sierra Madre del Sur in Guerrero, Mexico; endemic. Favors humid evergreen forest and shade-coffee plantations.

name: Orange River White-eye
rangeDescription: Namibia and northern south africa (northern cape, north west, and free state)
description: A small, active, yellow-green warbler-like bird with an obvious white eye-ring. The peach-colored underparts are diagnostic.

name: Perija Metaltail
rangeDescription: Sierra de perijá (colombia/venezuela border)
description: Small, short-billed hummingbird found only in the Perijá Mountains, which straddle the border between Colombia and Venezuela. Similar to the more common Tyrian Metalail, but larger with a longer coppery (not bluish) tail; male is also darker and female has speckles on the throat.

name: White-spotted Wattle-eye
rangeDescription: Forest of southern ivory coast to nigeria, gabon, and northern democratic republic of the congo
description: A pied wattle-eye of lowland forests. Males are white below with an iridescent black belt.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Night Parrot
rangeDescription: Arid interior of western and central australia (on verge of extinction)
description: Shy, elusive, and very rare nocturnal ground-dwelling parrot of inhabit arid environments, where it nests inside large spinifex clumps. Primarily green with yellow-green underparts and blackish markings throughout, less extensive than in longer-tailed Ground Parrot, in which adults have pale eyes (Night Parrot has dark eyes).

name: Black-winged Flycatcher-shrike
rangeDescription: Thai-malay peninsula, sumatra, and associated islands (simeulue, nias, riau and lingga archipelagos, bangka and belitung islands), borneo (including banggi, off northern borneo), java, and bali
description: Small forest-dwelling bird; glossy black above and white below, with a slight gray cast to the chest. Forages at upper and middle levels of the lowland and hill forests, hawking from exposed perches and often moving as part of a mixed flock.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Atlantic Royal Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais, rio de janeiro, são paulo, and paraná)
description: Endemic to southeastern Brazil. Uncommon, medium-sized, overall brown flycatcher of humid tropical forest in lowlands.

name: Sao Tome Ibis
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: Very small, dark forest-dwelling ibis. Note the dark blue bare skin on the face, the ragged crest, and the glossy green shoulders.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Sulawesi Myna
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region, including lembeh (off northeast) and muna and buton islands (off southeast)
description: A glossy-black starling with a rounded crest and prominent pale markings on cheeks and breast sides. Juvenile dark brown with a pale underside.
